verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page: a secure, pre-built page hosted by Airwallex that accepts multiple payment methods through a single integration, with custom styling to match the merchant's site. Its quickstart covers an end-to-end redirect to that page, and Payment Links and a hosted billing checkout offer further no-UI options. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the hosted page itself is conversion-optimized (multi-currency pricing is documented only as a separate API), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
